title: Claude Code + Obsidian: My family’s AI brain | Scott Farrar
author: Claire Vo
description: Watch now (34 mins) | 🎙️ Scott Farrar walks through the Claude Code and Obsidian system he built to track appliances, chase insurance quotes, and keep household projects moving
summary: Scott Farrar is a math educator and parent who got tired of AI chats that drift and forget. So he built a household brain in Claude Code: a folder of Markdown files, viewed in Obsidian, that knows his appliances, warranties, insurance documents, and everything on his family’s to-do list.
takeaways: So he built a household brain in Claude Code: a folder of Markdown files, viewed in Obsidian, that knows his appliances, warranties, insurance documents, and everything on his family’s to-do list.
We also talk about AI and math learning, and why he wants AI to keep kids doing the thinking.
In this episode, Scott shows how he uses it to shop for car insurance, plan repairs, share the system with his wife, and put priority tasks and recent wins on a wall display.
